Hi Olivia — great to hear you're ready to onboard. Attaching our AP onboarding packet and a sample PO CSV to show the fields we match on. High level answers below, but please see the attached packet for full specs and the DocuSign link to complete vendor legal details.

Key PO fields we require for automated matching (please ensure these are on the PO):
- Redwood Invoice Recipient (our legal entity name) and Redwood vendor ID (we'll provide once vendor is created)
- PO number (mandatory, unique per order)
- PO date
- Billing currency (EUR/GBP/USD)
- Line-level description or SKU reference (matches our invoice line items)
- Quantity, unit price, and tax amount (if tax shown)
- Remit-to bank instructions / remit ID if paying to a non-standard account

On EU VAT withholding: Redwood generally invoices gross (full amount) and expects receipt of gross value. If a customer is required to withhold tax at source, we accept that but need a formal certificate of withholding from the payer and the net amount posted on the remittance so our finance team can reconcile. Please see the attached "EU_VAT_Withholding_Guide.docx" — it outlines required evidence (withholding certificate or tax authority notice), the remittance format, and how we apply credit to our receivable.

Action items for Lighthaus:
1) Fill and sign the attached AP onboarding packet (DocuSign link in attachments).
2) Send a sample PO (PDF or CSV) from the entity that will pay Redwood so we can validate matching.
3) If you will be withholding, include a sample remittance report and the applicable withholding certificate so we can map credits correctly.

Attachments: Redwood_AP_Onboarding_Packet.pdf (AP packet, includes vendor form and bank remit instructions), Redwood_PO_Field_Sample.csv (sample PO fields), EU_VAT_Withholding_Guide.docx

Hi Olivia — thanks, quick answers below and an attached example remittance layout we prefer.

Short answers:
- Invoice policy: Redwood issues invoices at gross (we do not re-issue net invoices). Please post the gross PO/invoice and remit the net amount after withholding. We will require the withholding certificate/evidence to apply a credit for the withheld portion.
- PO flagging: add a custom PO field named "WITHHOLDING_APPLIED" with values YES/NO (or include a line-level tax withholding element). If your AP system cannot add custom fields, include a note in the PO description and send the remittance file to lighthaus-payments@lighthaus.com and cc our finance alias billing@redwood.com.

Attached: a sample remittance CSV layout called "Lighthaus_Remittance_Sample.csv" (first column = PO number, second = gross amount, third = withholding amount, fourth = net remitted, fifth = withholding certificate reference).
